evidence.source: The paper reports B3LYP, Gaussian 09, TS optimization, charge/multiplicity conventions and IRC at the same level. (page 9, block 6)
The implemented protocol uses transition-state optimization and forward/reverse IRC validation. (page 9, block 6)
The paper reports C10 alpha instability, short-chain beta OH quenching, and stabilized C15/C17 alpha direct dehydrogenation. (page 5, block 7)
